verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents an official `bq` CLI for creating datasets, loading data and querying tables, plus programmatic access through SDKs, the Storage Write API and JDBC/ODBC drivers. It can also be automated through scheduled load jobs, Dataform scheduled workflows and Git-managed pipelines, so the core of headless automation is covered. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, documented non-interactive auth (e.g., service accounts) for headless runs, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
